name: Wall Plug Connector
description: PCB-mount AC wall plug connector. Body is 26.58×3.92×5.76mm. Two 5.04mm-diameter prongs (22mm long) extend from the front face for plugging into a wall outlet. On the back, L-shaped leads first extend 7.06mm horizontally (3.77mm wide, 3.07mm tall), then bend downward into 0.82mm-diameter pins that descend 8.40mm for through-hole mounting. Mounts through the enclosure side wall so the prongs protrude outside the device. Cutout matches the full body cross-section.

pins.label: Live
pins.description: Live AC terminal. L-shaped lead bends down from the back of the body into a 0.82mm pin.

pins.label: Neutral
pins.description: Neutral AC terminal. L-shaped lead bends down from the back of the body into a 0.82mm pin.

features.label: L-bend lead channel (Live)
features.description: Clearance for the horizontal portion of the L-shaped Live lead extending from the back of the body to the pin drop point.

features.label: L-bend lead channel (Neutral)
features.description: Clearance for the horizontal portion of the L-shaped Neutral lead extending from the back of the body to the pin drop point.
